title: Vivec preview frame and its joins to the world
rule: The Vivec Arena preview is one isolated frame: what lies at or beyond its edge (canton cuts, sea, bridges, the open-world maps around it) is missing, cut or wrong until the world streamer joins Vivec to the world.

title: Collision shapes and climbing (stairs, ramps, walkways)
rule: Convex collision proxies invent steep faces or bury authored surfaces; Morrowind collides with authored geometry (step up 34 units, slope up to 46 degrees). Rule: follow_original_stair_rules plus a walkability gate.

title: Distance drawing (horizon, fog, sky, far edges)
rule: Far-plane fog, the skyline fill, distant sprites and resident ground.

title: Seyda Neen recorded stage
rule: Recorded v0.0.31 maps are kept byte for byte; their heap headroom limits what can be added and the public builder cannot regenerate them.

title: Content silently missing from a build
rule: Every omission is receipted; payload and entity counts are compared with the last release; shipped features are on by default.

title: Builder breaks and reproducibility
rule: The repository builder builds the whole game from the owner's data with no private step, byte for byte the same each time.

title: Build speed
rule: Every stage on the shared worker pool; per-stage time and CPU in the build profile.

title: Build reuse keys and output attribution
rule: A unit is rebuilt only when the content hash of all its inputs changes or its output is missing or damaged. Keys never under-declare (a missed input allows a wrong reuse) and should not over-declare (a file no output depends on forces rebuilds); outputs carry no wall-clock values; every changed file is credited to the stage that wrote it.

title: Console, keyboard and mouse input
rule: The console line editor, qualifier keys and the emulator key path.

title: Music and sound
rule: The mixer must stay fed through loads and scene changes; music starts after loads settle.

title: Lighting, lamps and night
rule: Morrowind lights become Quake light entities baked by the light compiler and animated with lightstyles; night tables and dynamic lights follow the original.

title: First-person hands and torch
rule: First-person hands, punches and the carried torch.

title: Map heap and memory budget
rule: The heap model must match what the loader actually allocates; strict heap gate, hard ceiling always fatal.

title: Engine table limits
rule: Fixed engine tables (models, entities, faces, texinfo, flames, lamps, door rows) are checked by the builder before a map ships, never discovered in play.

title: Mesh converter geometry
rule: Converted faces must be planar, wound to their plane, non-degenerate and within engine ranges; checked by the face validator.

title: World storage and duplication
rule: Every asset stored once and placed by reference (world streamer); map lumps carry only what the engine uses.

title: Loading and disk reads
rule: Load time follows bytes read and seeks on FFS; measured with read counters, not wall time alone.

title: Rendering cost and visibility
rule: Read the visibility data and renderer counters before any performance claim.

title: CHIM world streamer
rule: The CHIM streamer keeps Quake's visibility effective and its renderer counters must not get worse.

title: FPU and CPU behaviour (68040/68060)
rule: Results must not depend on the FPU; unimplemented instructions trap on a real 68040 without a support library.

title: Emulator measurement method
rule: Emulator numbers are relative until a hardware number exists; same-session runs with a drift control.

title: Disk images, partitions and launchers
rule: Classic FFS limits: partitions under 2 GiB, few files per directory; launchers list every disk.

title: Morrowind editions, archives and inputs
rule: The builder reads the owner's data the way Morrowind does (archive order, loose files) and checks inputs against known versions.

title: Object placement and in-game geometry
rule: Placed objects match the original (OpenMW A/B at the same pose).

title: Actors and NPCs
rule: Actor placement, models and behaviour; the actor placement gate.

title: Harvestable plants
rule: Harvest catalogues are built by the builder for the shipped maps and counted by the entity tracker.

title: Town and interior import
rule: The town importer converts every town and interior within engine limits; doors lead somewhere.

title: Scene changes, arrivals and handoffs
rule: Cell, region and scene changes keep the player, view, equipment and sound intact.

title: Menus, HUD, map screen and text
rule: Menus, HUD, map screen, fonts and messages.

title: Debug commands and remote control
rule: dbg commands, teleports, debug map loads and the remote console.

title: Boot and engine start-up
rule: The boot check and engine start-up report problems clearly and never stop the game silently.

title: Game logic (QuakeC) and saves
rule: QuakeC entities, saves and game state.

title: Gates, CI and tests
rule: A check that is skipped, tests the wrong tree or depends on the host is not a check; skips fail loudly.

title: Development tooling, receipts and packaging
rule: Receipts, packaging, development tools and the tracker itself.
